name: branding-leaf-detailed-wordmark-skincare-label-and-ribbon
title: Skincare wordmark with sprouting leaf detailing on letters, paper label and satin ribbon
whatItIs: A white slide with a black wordmark 'Biofilia' where the i's dots and the tall l are drawn as small leaves, plus two application photos: a cream paper label on tissue, and a pink satin ribbon printed with the wordmark on a green suede background.
whatItMeans: Natural, quiet and gentle; leaf details bring life to a rational sans without extra icons.
techniques: Replace letter dots with leaf shapes.
Grow a stem from one letter to add a botanical flourish.
Print the wordmark repeatedly on satin ribbon.
Photograph on a matching muted green fabric.

vocabulary.definition: An i-dot replaced by a leaf.
A symbol built into the letterforms.
A logo repeated on a ribbon.
A soft matte fabric surface used in photography.
